parameters.content:
## Inbound SMS
STOP-style replies add the number to the DNC sheet, set Do-Not-Disturb in GoHighLevel, move the opportunity to Do Not Contact and cancel pending AI callbacks. Other replies are logged to the contact and forwarded to agents. Twilio itself also blocks further texts to a number that replies STOP.

return (base.alertNumbers || []).filter(Boolean).map((n) => ({ json: { cfg: base.cfg, smsTo: n, smsBody: base.alertText } }));
